title: OpenMage LTS fixes a CVSS 9.3 stored XSS that lets a guest shopper hijack admin sessions via a crafted email. Upgrade to 20.19.1 or 20.18.3.
content_md:
OpenMage LTS fixes a CVSS 9.3 stored XSS that lets a guest shopper hijack admin sessions via a crafted email. Upgrade to 20.19.1 or 20.18.3.

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/openmage-lts-stored-xss/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social
